news.title: Clayton says he trusts Trump ‘completely’ after calling Putin a friend
news.summary: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton on Sunday said he trusts President Trump “completely” after he called Russian President Vladimir Putin, a perceived U.S. adversary, a friend. CNN’s Dana Bash on “State of the Union” showed Clayton two Truth Social posts from the president referring to Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping as his friends,…
